sections.Profile:
The Rocket III pinball machine, produced by Bally Manufacturing Co. in 1967, is an electro-mechanical game designed by Ted Zale, with artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Space, Original Theme, Planets, Single level playfield

- Design: Ted Zale

- Art: Christian Marche
